details.description:
Discover the authentic flavours of South India with Ambika Appalam Depot's delectable food products. Crafted using high-quality ingredients and cutting-edge technology, our appalams and other South Indian delicacies are manufactured in a meticulous, hygienic process that ensures the utmost freshness and flavour. Enjoy the versatility of these light, crisp appalams - roast, microwave, or deep fry them for a delightful snack or side dish that perfectly complements your meal.
With Ambika Appalam, you can indulge in the rich, authentic tastes of the South, made with care and passion by our expert team. Elevate your culinary experience with the unparalleled quality and flavour of Ambika Appalam Depot.
details.ingredients: Urid Flour, Rice Flour, Salt, Permitted acid regulator and firming agent E 170 (1) (not exceeding 0.5%), Edible Vegetable Oil
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
